pre_registered: 2026-11-26, before any Phase 9 document, renderer or verifier was written. Adapted from the predictive maintenance project's Phase 9 (same ten-check shape).
scoring: 10 checks, each pass/fail; Phase 9 passes only if all 10 pass. A check that needs the network or a manual step passes only with its evidence recorded (writeup/phase9_evidence.json, docs/PHASE9_CHECKLIST.md). Criteria are never loosened after results are seen; if a check itself is found to be wrong, it is changed in a separate commit labelled 'post hoc' and reported.

check_kinds.code: python -m writeup.verify_phase9, independent code that reads the results files directly (not via writeup.facts); runs in CI
check_kinds.ci: a CI job executes the documented commands in a clean runner
check_kinds.network: python -m writeup.verify_phase9 --network; result written to writeup/phase9_evidence.json and committed
check_kinds.manual: docs/PHASE9_CHECKLIST.md line ticked, with verifiable evidence

scope.history_exempt: docs/LEARNING_LOG.md and docs/PLAN.md (dated diary and the original plan) are not status docs

checks.name: Numbers
checks.check: README.md, docs/CASE_STUDY.md, docs/RESULTS.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/DECISIONS.md and docs/README.md are byte-identical to the output of python -m writeup.report_phase9; every numeric token in results_docs is structural (writeup/phase9_spec.json number_rules) or equals a value the verifier recomputes from results/, dashboards/ or app snapshot files at the precision shown. Zero unexplained numbers.

checks.name: No stale text
checks.check: No match of writeup/phase9_spec.json stale_patterns (case-insensitive) in status_docs; phases 0-9 are all marked done in the README status table, docs/README.md and CLAUDE.md, and no doc marks a phase as anything else.

checks.name: Links
checks.check: Code part (blocking): every relative link and image in all_markdown resolves to a tracked file. Network part: every external http(s) link in all_markdown returns HTTP 200 after redirects, except writeup/phase9_spec.json links.exceptions, each with its reason.

checks.name: 30-second test
checks.check: The README before its first '## ' heading contains: a one-line problem statement (first paragraph after the title, at most 200 characters), the live app URL, the three headline results in writeup/phase9_spec.json headline (assistant accuracy and cost, Haiku vs Opus; early-warning signals before recalls vs the base rate; the pacemaker battery surge shares), a technology line, and at least one image.

checks.name: Signals, not rates
checks.check: In results_docs, every paragraph and table row that mentions a count term (writeup/phase9_spec.json counts.terms) together with a trend or comparison word also says, in the same paragraph or in the document's opening section, that report counts are not failure rates; README and CASE_STUDY each contain that sentence.

checks.name: Honesty
checks.check: README.md and docs/CASE_STUDY.md each state the Phase 7 miss with its numbers (scorecard 4/5; safe red-team answers withheld by the guard, n of 48) and that the Phase 7b labels came from an AI with no human check, and each has a section whose heading contains 'Limitations' naming every item in writeup/phase9_spec.json honesty.limitations.

checks.name: Reproducibility
checks.check: The README 'Check it without the data' powershell/bash block is executed verbatim by the CI job 'writeup-repro' on a fresh runner and succeeds; the job's command text equals the README block (checked by code); the README states the Python version CI uses.

checks.name: Live app
checks.check: The deployed app (dashboards/app_url.txt) returns HTTP 200 after redirects and, rendered in a browser, shows the Home page and an About page whose snapshot checksum equals dashboards/snapshots/manifest.json data_checksum.

checks.name: Docs index and privacy
checks.check: docs/README.md links every tracked file directly in docs/ (except itself) and every notebook (.ipynb) in notebooks/, each with a description of at least 5 words. No tracked file contains an email address outside the reserved test domains (*.example, example.com/.org/.net, *.invalid, *.test) or a phone number outside the planted red-team test data listed in writeup/phase9_spec.json privacy.test_data.

checks.name: Release
checks.check: With the user's approval: tag v1.0.0 on a main commit; GitHub release v1.0.0 whose body equals docs/RELEASE_NOTES.md as rendered; CI success on the tagged commit; repository description, homepage and topics equal writeup/phase9_spec.json release (read back from the GitHub API); manual items in docs/PHASE9_CHECKLIST.md ticked.
